title: Aashoor Ko Nouha Tha Yahi Binte Ali ka
body:
Aashoor ko nouha tha yahi binte Ali ka
Katt jayega ab pyaasa gala sibte nabi ka
1. Betoun ke janazoun pe kiya shukr ka sajda
Dekhay tou koi housla ye binte Ali ka
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Pamaal bana hogaya jab dashte bala may
Farwa ne kaha lutt gaya ab raaj bani ka
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Shai kahte thay Abbas ke lashe pa ye rookar
Kya haal layeeno ne kiya mere aqii ka
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Abbas e Ali soogaye darya ke kinaare
Allah nigehbaan hai ab aal e nabi ka
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Shai kehne lage aakay ye laashe pa pisar ke
Aye laal ajab haal hai ab teri phupi ka
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Rooti rahi zindan may wo khoon ke aansun
Har lamha Sakina ki tha gham be pidari ka
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Kya guzri hai sahil dil e Zainab pe na poocho
Barbad gulistan huwa jab binte nabi ka
Azz: alamdar sahil
